title: Catch It Before It Crashes
statementMd:
Dividing by zero throws an **ArithmeticException** and stops the program. Catch it instead: print the result of `a / b`, or `Cannot divide by zero` when b is 0.

**Input**
Two integers `a b`.

**Output**
The whole-number result, or `Cannot divide by zero`.

Use try/catch — don’t check b with an `if`. Catching the exception is the point of this level.
hints: Put the risky line inside try { … } and handle the failure in catch (ArithmeticException e) { … }.
Integer division by zero throws ArithmeticException; the catch block runs instead of the program crashing.
